scheme_name: AICTE - YOUTH UNDERTAKING VISIT FOR ACQUIRING KNOWLEDGE (YUVAK): STUDY TOUR OF ATAL TUNNEL, HIMACHAL PRADESH
other_conditions: Institution must be AICTE approved and have a latest NIRF ranking between 001 and 500. Team must consist of 10 students and 1 faculty member from each eligible institute.
benefits_summary: Financial grant of up to ₹1,70,000‑₹2,00,000 per institute covering travel, transport, and lodging for a team of 10 students and 1 faculty member.
